decision.explanation: The correct answer is Germany, as confirmed by D3S1 (document 3) which clearly states 'While Germany came through with an impressive 1-0 victory in extra time over Argentina to take home the 2014 World Cup title.' This directly supports the claim that Germany won the 2014 World Cup Final. The conflicting claim in D1S1 (document 1) stating Spain won is factually incorrect based on real-world knowledge and contradicted by the accurate document. Spain was eliminated in the semifinals by Germany in 2014.
